messages.content: Analyze symptoms: {{9.Symptoms}}, severity: {{9.Severity}}, history: {{map(if(length(51.array) > 1; slice(51.array; 1; length(51.array)); emptyarray); \ + "Date: \\\" + formatDate(9.`Timestamp Creation`; \\\ + "YYYY-MM-DD\\\") + \\\ + ", Symptoms: \\\" + 9.Symptoms + \\\ + ", Diagnosis: \\\" + 9.Diagnosis + \\\ + ", Severity: \\\" + 9.Severity; \\\ + "\\\\n\\\")}}. Employ Bayesian-like inference for differential diagnosis. Output JSON with exactly one of two structures: 1) If insufficient data (e.g., vague symptoms, missing pain scale, unclear history), return {\"question\": \"targeted query to elicit clarifying details\", \"status\": \"clarification_needed\"}. 2) If sufficient, return {\"diagnosis\": \"precise etiology\", \"severity\": \"Low|Medium|High|Critical\", \"prediction\": \"prognostic risks from patterns\", \"status\": \"diagnosis_made\"}. Ensure 'status' is always either 'clarification_needed' or 'diagnosis_made'. Do not include additional fields or deviate from this format.
